text:
deploy-bot: Starting gradual regional canary for /v2 endpoints — ap-southeast region, 5% of traffic. Canary tags: model=v2-default, quant=4bit. Change window: 1h. Watch p95, 5xx, and eval regressions. Links: https://ci/internal/deploys/2013456789 :robot_face:
alex_p: Ack. I'll tail the inference logs and latency dashboards.
morgan: Heads up — mobile SDK hasn't rolled the header to opt into v2. Recommend pinning mobile traffic to v1 until SDK release.
pm_tess: Important metrics to monitor: p95 latency, 5xx rate, and semantic eval score on the regression set. Do we have a rollback runbook for this canary?
juan: Runbook is here: https://wiki/internal/deploys/runbooks#v2-canary. Quick rollback option: toggle routing to model-variant=v1-legacy or set x-model-variant: legacy header. Can do in <2min.
dana: Ops can add a header-based routing rule to pin user-agent "MobileSDK" to v1; lower blast radius. I'll patch ingress now.
deploy-bot: Ingress rule patch applied: mobile UA -> v1 pin. Canary live at 5% ap-southeast. Pager conditions set: 5xx > 0.5% for 10m OR p95 > 450ms for 10m. Notifying oncall.
alex_p: Noticing a small p95 bump for sequences >1024 tokens in ap-southeast, from 320ms -> ~470ms. Captured a sample trace: ```TRACE_ID=tx-9a8b curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' 
https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"long context...","max_tokens":2048}'``` Investigating whether kernel selection or batching is the cause.
morgan: If this persists or semantic eval drops, fallback plan is to route to model-variant=v2-stable (less aggressive quant). Can we flip that by header x-model-variant?
juan: Yes, we have a flag in routing: header x-model-variant. I'll prepare a toggle in the rollout console and test it in staging.
pm_tess: Also add a note for release notes: mobile remains pinned to v1, new header x-client-api-version accepted for explicit opt-in, and model-variant header supported for emergency rollbacks. @maria-docs please draft the entry.
maria-docs: Draft PR opened: https://git.internal/docs/pr/4321 — includes migration snippet and header examples. Will iterate if there are any wording changes.
alex_p: p95 trending back to baseline after micro-adjust to batching knobs, no increase in 5xx. Holding at 5% for 30 more minutes before ramp decision.
dana: Ops suggests ramp to 25% after the hold if no regressions. We'll schedule ramp at +35m from now and have @lee on call.
lee: Oncall ack — I'll be available for the window.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: ramp to 25% at 2013460389. I'll post status updates at each step. If any pager fires or manual rollback requested, I'll pause the rollout. :rocket:
